thesis.text: Amigo Resources is layering PGM, graphite and copper-matte optionality onto an unproven Tanzanian gold gravity-recovery operation; each new workstream (PGM concentration circuits, pyrometallurgical furnace trial, STAMICO graphite tailings, Kabete historical-drilling validation) is explicitly preliminary, non-representative or conceptual per the company's own disclaimers, with no JORC resource, economic study, or updated financial disclosure accompanying the claims. The thesis remains speculative and catalyst-dependent: near-term value hinges on independently verified metallurgical/economic data and the still-pending Q4 2026 gold plant commissioning, while the widening set of unproven commodity narratives raises promotional and disclosure risk rather than reducing it.
